name: posthog-squad
description: Single-agent PostHog squad: installs the PostHog MCP, agrees on north-star events, then runs a daily digest — DAU/WAU/MAU, progression, top engaged users, and users at risk of churning.
author: pancake-official

required_vault_secrets.label: PostHog personal API key (scoped to the target project — Settings → Personal API keys → read access on Query, Insight, Event definition, Action, Person, Cohort)
PostHog project ID (numeric — Settings → Project → 'Project ID')
PostHog host — 'https://us.posthog.com', 'https://eu.posthog.com', or a self-hosted base URL
Comma-separated PostHog event names that count as 'real product use' (e.g. message_sent,workspace_created) — agreed during onboarding
The single PostHog event that means a new signup is now 'activated' (e.g. first_message_sent). One event name, no commas.
